apps.name: Antena
apps.tagline: Local alerts, chat bot and widgets for Meld Studio
apps.description: Free, local alerts, chat bot, timers, widgets, giveaways and tier lists for Meld Studio on Twitch and YouTube, fully controllable via MCP.

news.title: Antena 0.21.0
news.text: Custom widgets with settings forms, a social bar and a separate ticker with its own event types.

news.title: Antena 0.20.1
news.text: Independent alert background positioning, rotating on-screen messages and chat previews in Meld.

news.title: Antena 0.20.0
news.text: Saved themes, plus custom overlays that follow the on-air scene and embed animated widget slots.

news.title: Antena 0.19.0
news.text: Discord live announcements that update themselves, and scheduled streams from your stream calendar.

news.title: Antena 0.18.1
news.text: Create, edit and run interviews from the panel and the dock, and stop them live without deleting them.

apps.name: Quorb

apps.description: Edge-docked usage rings for Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter and more on Windows: live limits, burn rate, history and alerts.

news.title: Quorb 0.9.1
news.text: First Linux release (.deb and .AppImage) and Linux credentials that persist across reboots.

news.title: Quorb 0.9.0
news.text: NaN credits, WSL support on Windows, email alerts and the OpenCode Go and Antigravity providers.
